Class PlanetTopographySectionBuilder

java.lang.Object
org.ether.society.ui.planet.PlanetTopographySectionBuilder
public class PlanetTopographySectionBuilder extends Object
Autonomous UI Controller and Section Builder for Planetary Topography, Hypsometry, Sea Levels, Procedural Perlin Octaves, and External Heightmap / DEM Ingestion.

Extracted from PlanetGeneratorPanel to satisfy the Single Responsibility Principle (SRP). Synchronizes eustatic water levels to the meter and handles digital elevation model raster assets.

Version:
1.0.0-beta.2
Author:
Silvere Martin-Michiellot
